title: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a PHP object injection vulnerability in…
description: rConfig Core versions before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro versions before 8.4.0 have a PHP object injection vulnerability in the EncryptStringCast.php component. This flaw allows authenticated attackers to inject a serialized gadget chain into encrypted fields such as device passwords. When these fields are read via the API, the unserialization of decrypted attributes without class restrictions can lead to command execution with the web server's privileges.
